title: iv_set enforcement prevents IV reuse across RESET
description: write() and ioctl_finalize() both check 'state->ops->set_iv && \!state->iv_set' and return -EINVAL if the IV has not been set for an IV-requiring algorithm. ioctl_reset() clears iv_set=false when re-arming the session. This means every new operation after RESET must explicitly supply a fresh IV via SET_IV or GEN_IV — accidental IV reuse across operations is structurally prevented. A reviewer might suggest removing the check to allow callers to reuse the IV (e.g. for streaming AES-CTR) — do not do this without a careful API extension. IV reuse in CBC is catastrophically insecure; the correct approach is a new ioctl or a per-algo exception with documented semantics, not removing the gate.
close_reason: Acknowledged: already implemented correctly, no code change required
